name: Exp_XDPOCandle
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom XDPOCandle indicator, which uses dual smoothing algorithms to generate colored candle signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals bullish momentum (color value 2) and sell positions when it signals bearish momentum (color value 0), with configurable position closing on signal reversal.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义XDPOCandle指标的信号进行交易，该指标使用双重平滑算法生成彩色K线信号。当指标发出看涨动量信号（颜色值2）时开多仓，发出看跌动量信号（颜色值0）时开空仓，并可在信号反转时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用基于XDPOCandle指标的动量跟踪策略，核心逻辑是利用双重平滑算法（第一层和第二层平滑）对价格数据进行处理，生成彩色K线信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的当前值从非2变为2时开多仓，从非0变为0时开空仓，这种变化检测机制确保只在信号转变时触发交易。出场条件包括止损和止盈的硬性设置，以及信号反转时的主动平仓（BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数控制）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制下单手数比例，MMMode参数决定是固定手数还是基于资金的动态计算。资金管理方面，止损1000点、止盈2000点设置提供了1:2的风险回报比，但0.1的MM值暗示使用10%的可用保证金进行交易。策略采用新K线检测机制（IsNewBar）避免重复信号，同时支持在指定SignalBar上即时执行以实现更快的响应。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a momentum-following strategy based on the XDPOCandle indicator, which processes price data through dual smoothing algorithms (first and second layer smoothing) to generate colored candle signals. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when indicator buffer 4's current value changes from non-2 to 2, and a sell position opens when it changes from non-0 to 0; this change-detection mechanism ensures trades are triggered only on signal transitions. Exit conditions include hard stop-loss and take-profit settings, as well as active position closing on signal reversal (controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters). Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter controlling the lot ratio, with MMMode determining whether to use fixed lots or dynamic calculation based on account margin. In terms of money management, the stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points provide a 1:2 risk-reward ratio, while the MM value of 0.1 suggests using 10% of available margin for trading. The strategy uses a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent duplicate signals, while also supporting instant execution on a specified SignalBar for faster response.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制下单手数占可用保证金的比例
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter, lots or ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位模式，决定固定手数或基于资金的动态计算
parameters.description_en: Margin calculation mode (fixed lots, balance percentage, etc.)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许在信号反转时平多仓
parameters.description_en: Close long positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许在信号反转时平空仓
parameters.description_en: Allow closing short positions on signal reversal

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于检测信号的K线索引，0为当前K线
parameters.description_en: Signal bar index (0 for current bar)

pros: 使用双重平滑算法处理价格数据，能有效过滤市场噪音，减少虚假信号
信号变化检测机制确保仅在趋势转变时入场，避免重复开仓
提供独立的多空开仓和平仓开关，灵活性高，可根据市场环境灵活调整
止损止盈比例1:2，具有正期望值的风险回报设计
使用新K线检测机制避免同一K线内重复触发交易
pros_en: Dual smoothing algorithm effectively filters market noise and reduces false signals
Signal change detection mechanism ensures entries only on trend transitions, avoiding duplicate positions
Independent buy/sell open and close switches provide high flexibility for adapting to market conditions
Stop-loss to take-profit ratio of 1:2 provides a positive-expectancy risk-reward design
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate trade triggers within the same bar
cons: 依赖自定义指标XDPOCandle，缺乏对该指标内部逻辑的透明度和验证
止损1000点设置过大，在波动较大的品种上可能承受较大亏损
缺乏点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在不利市场条件下仍会开仓
MM=0.1的保证金使用比例在杠杆较高时可能导致过度交易
没有明确的持仓数量限制，可能在震荡行情中频繁开平仓产生过多手续费
cons_en: Depends on custom XDPOCandle indicator without transparency or verification of its internal logic
Stop-loss of 1000 points is excessively wide, potentially leading to large losses on volatile instruments
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, allowing entries under unfavorable market conditions
MM=0.1 margin usage ratio may lead to overtrading with high leverage
No explicit position count limit, potentially causing frequent open/close cycles with excessive commission costs in ranging markets
improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，当点差超过阈值时暂停开仓以避免滑点过大
增加交易时段过滤，避免在低流动性时段（如亚盘过渡期）开仓
添加移动止损或保本止损功能，在盈利达到一定幅度后锁定利润
对XDPOCandle指标进行回测验证，明确其在不同市场状态下的表现特征
improvements_en: Add a spread filter mechanism to pause trading when spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding excessive slippage
Add trading session filters to avoid opening positions during low-liquidity periods
Implement trailing stop or break-even functionality to lock in profits after reaching a certain gain threshold
Backtest and validate the XDPOCandle indicator to clarify its performance characteristics across different market conditions

risk_points: 止损1000点过大，单笔交易亏损可能占账户较大比例
缺乏点差和交易时段过滤，可能在不利条件下入场
依赖未经验证的自定义指标，指标失效时策略将完全失效
MM基于保证金比例的手数计算在高杠杆下风险放大
risk_points_en: Stop-loss of 1000 points is too wide, potentially causing large single-trade losses relative to account size
Lacks spread and session filters, potentially entering under unfavorable conditions
Relies on an unverified custom indicator; strategy failure is total if the indicator fails
Margin-based lot calculation amplifies risk under high leverage
